title: Sum-evaluation normalization of the etale right-adjoint tensor map
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $e:U\to X$ a separated etale finite-type morphism of Noetherian schemes. A Noetherian scheme means one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Choose a compactification of $e$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Work in the ordinary unbounded small-etale derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with exact pullback $e^*$ and derived tensor [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact, def-kun-derived-tensor]. Put $F_e=Re_!$, let $F_e\dashv G_e$ have counit $\varepsilon_e$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], and let $S_e=D(e_{\Sigma!})\dashv e^*$ have sum/evaluation counit $\operatorname{ev}_e$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension, lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality]. Let $d_e:F_e\xrightarrow{\sim}S_e$ be the canonical proper-support comparison followed by the identification with sum extension in [lem-sfb-quasifinite-compact-support-exact]. Define $\rho_e=(d_e^{-1})^c:G_e\to e^*$ by adjunction conjugacy [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], put $W_e=G_eA_X$, and let $\eta_e:W_e\to A_U$ be $\rho_{e,A_X}$ followed by the coefficient-unit pullback comparison.

Then $\rho_e$ is a natural isomorphism, uniquely characterized by
$$\operatorname{ev}_{e,K}\circ S_e(\rho_{e,K})\circ d_{e,G_eK}=\varepsilon_{e,K}.$$
Let $P_{e,M,K}:F_eM\otimes_A^LK\xrightarrow{\sim}F_e(M\otimes_A^Le^*K)$ be the specified compactification projection of [lem-pur-etale-support-map-compatibility](2). Define $\tau_{e,K}:e^*K\otimes_A^LW_e\to G_eK$ to be the $F_e\dashv G_e$ adjunct of
$$F_e(e^*K\otimes W_e)\xrightarrow{F_e(\mathrm{sym})}F_e(W_e\otimes e^*K)\xrightarrow{P_{e,W_e,K}^{-1}}F_eW_e\otimes K\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{e,A_X}\otimes1}A_X\otimes K\xrightarrow{\sim}K.$$
For every $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$,
$$\rho_{e,K}\circ\tau_{e,K}=\operatorname{unitor}\circ(1_{e^*K}\otimes\eta_e):e^*K\otimes_A^LW_e\longrightarrow e^*K.$$
This is an equality of derived natural transformations with the specified proper-support and projection normalizations, independent of compactification under the canonical refinement comparisons. It is preserved by restriction to Cartesian open subsquares.

proof.text: The sum projection inverse is the unit-defined projection mate. The direct termwise-localization adjunction and mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction coincide: first prove the counit formula on complexes for abstract abelian categories by expanding the homotopy-level factorization and cancelling the identity quotient comparisons, then compare counits after precomposition with the complex localization. Keeping the localization calculation abstract avoids expensive unfolding of concrete sheaf constructions. Transpose its counit equation using the Hom bijection: naturality of the exact-pullback tensorator and the right triangle identity identify both transposes. Transport the proved left-unit law of derived pullback through L(e*) isomorphic to D(e*). Composing the counit equation with the left unitor gives exactly the evaluation hypothesis of adjointProjectionTensorTransfer. Thus a separate sheaf-generator or K-flat unit-evaluation argument is unnecessary. The native derived symmetric structure uses the same canonical Koszul braiding as derivedTensorSymmetry.

proof.text: Apply adjointProjectionTensorTransfer with the specified projection isomorphisms, the canonical graph comparison and the exact sum/evaluation adjunction. Joint naturality of the sum projection follows from its curried natural isomorphism; that of the compactification projection follows by cancellation in the comparison square. The transfer theorem gives the displayed tau normalization and naturality. The conjugacy counit identity and injectivity of the sum Hom bijection prove the stated iff characterization of rho.

proof.text: Use comparison-coherence refinement clauses for rho and eta; cancel rho at K and use tau normalization twice to obtain the refinement equation. For an open subsquare, identify the equality-transport spelling of beta with the upperStarComp spelling by equality elimination. The comparison-coherence open clauses identify chi and the coefficient transport. Package tau as natural transformations using its already-proved naturality, apply tensor_open, and cancel the exact pullback tensor isomorphism to obtain the requested formula.
